review_candidates.title: Senior Payroll Specialist - MEA region
review_candidates.description: Are you an experienced payroll professional ready to broaden your international payroll expertise and take on a new regional challenge? We are looking for a Senior Payroll Specialist for the Middle East and Africa (MEA) region to join our international payroll team and support payroll operations across multiple countries. This is an opportunity to build strong knowledge of a diverse region, work with colleagues and stakeholders across different countries and cultures and expand your experience beyond the standard monthly payroll cycle. You will take ownership of monthly payroll activities, resolve payroll queries, support reporting and audits, and contribute to continuous improvement and regional payroll projects. What You Will Do As a Senior Payroll Specialist, you will support the accurate and timely payroll process for assigned countries and entities across the MEA region. You will coordinate monthly payroll activities, validate payroll data and employee changes, work closely with HR, Finance, employees, local stakeholders, and payroll partners, and help ensure each payroll cycle runs smoothly and accurately. You will also support reporting, audits, controls, documentation, and continuous improvements across the regional payroll environment. How You Will Do It Coordinate monthly payroll activities according to agreed payroll calendars, local requirements, and established processes. Collect, review, and validate monthly payroll inputs such as overtime, bonuses, allowances, absences, new hires, terminations, transfers, and other employee changes. Prepare and validate payroll data and follow up on payroll-related questions and discrepancies through to resolution. Perform payroll checks and controls, investigate variances, and ensure issues are resolved before payroll sign-off. Partner with HR, Finance, employees, local stakeholders, and payroll partners to resolve payroll-related queries. Support payroll reporting, audits, controls, and required documentation throughout the year. Maintain accurate payroll records and ensure payroll-related data is complete and up to date. Contribute to payroll process improvements, system changes, harmonization activities, and regional projects. Collaborate effectively with colleagues and stakeholders across different countries, cultures, and time zones. Take ownership of your activities, proactively investigate issues, seek information, and involve the right stakeholders when clarification is needed. Required What We Look For 3+ years of experience in payroll administration or payroll processing. Good understanding of payroll processes and monthly payroll cycles. Strong attention to detail and ability to work accurately with payroll data. Strong organizational skills and ability to manage deadlines and priorities. Confident written and spoken English. Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including lookups, pivot tables, and basic formulas. Proactive mindset and strong sense of ownership – you are comfortable investigating issues, asking questions, and driving tasks through to completion. Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with an international team. Strong problem-solving and communication skills. Comfort working with stakeholders across different countries and time zones. Preferred Experience working in an international or multicultural payroll environment. Experience supporting payroll across multiple countries. Previous exposure to MEA payroll would be a strong advantage, but is not essential. What You Will Gain This role gives you the opportunity to broaden your payroll expertise beyond a single country or market and develop valuable knowledge of payroll operations across the Middle East and Africa. You will gain exposure to different countries, local requirements, cultures, stakeholders, and ways of working while strengthening your experience in a truly international payroll environment. And the role goes beyond the monthly payroll cycle. You will have the opportunity to participate in regional projects, process improvements, audits, reporting, controls, system changes, and harmonization initiatives , allowing you to build a broader understanding of how payroll operates across an international organization. Whether you already have regional payroll experience or are looking to expand your existing payroll knowledge into a new area, this position offers the opportunity to deepen your expertise, broaden your regional exposure, and build experience that can support your next career step. If you are ready to take your payroll experience to the next level and expand your international expertise, we would be happy to hear from you. Our Salary And Benefits The initial basic salary for this position will be in the range of €1,830 - €2,754 per month, plus a 13th month salary applied after your first 6 months in the job. The final package will reflect your experience, skills, and qualifications relevant to the role. We are committed to fair, equitable, and gender-neutral pay practices. At Johnson Controls, your work comes with benefits that support both your career and your wellbeing. Meal vouchers fully covered by the company. Flexible benefits budget with access to 3,500+ options, including a MultiSport card, medical and wellness services. Extra savings through retail and lifestyle discounts (Benefit+). Allowance for the private kindergarten or nursery to support your family. Flexible working hours and home office days. Allowance for language courses, professional development support, and wellbeing support. On site benefits: massages, distribution of fruits, yoga, psychologist, health month, various events with supporting groups (volunteering activities, branding activities). Seniority benefits - extra monthly financial allowance, medical care and support, wellbeing day. Relocation support with housing allowance if moving to Slovakia About Us Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education. For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward. We are committed to diversity and inclusion and believe that different perspectives make us stronger. By encouraging open dialogue and valuing individuality, we strive to be one of the most desirable places to work.

review_candidates.title: SLAM算法工程师 (MJ001182)
review_candidates.description: 该职位来源于猎聘 岗位职责： 1. 负责多传感器融合（视觉、激光雷达、IMU等）的SLAM算法研发，为具身智能设备提供极其精准的自我运动轨迹（Ego-motion）与全局空间约束。 2. 负责多源传感器的时空同步方案设计与核心算法实现（包括时间戳对齐、软硬件触发、延迟补偿等），并协同内部系统工程师完成整机时间同步架构的统筹。 3. 针对动态与复杂室内外采集场景，研发高精度的视觉重定位、增量建图及地图更新算法，深度融合语义信息提升VSLAM前后端系统的鲁棒性。 任职要求： 1. 扎实的数学基础（矩阵论、多视图几何、非线性优化），熟练使用Eigen、Ceres、g2o等数学库。 2. 深入理解主流开源SLAM框架（VINS-Fusion、ORB-SLAM3、OpenVINS、MSCKF-VIO等），具备丰富的魔改与二次开发经验。 3. 具备深刻的多模态数据时空对齐认知，精通IMU误差模型与联合标定。 4. 有UMI或Egocentric感知系统量产级落地经验者优先考虑。 5. 计算机科学、人工智能、电子工程、数据工程等相关专业本科及以上学历。
